name: F – Options
plan: User's go 2026-10-20: (1) spy_put_spread, the income idea of paper/research/2026-10-11-account-F-put-selling.md: sell a ~0.25 delta SPY put, buy a ~0.10 delta put below, 30-45 days out, one a week, at most 4 open, ~3% of equity at risk each, out at 50% of the credit or 21 days before expiry; (2) long calls and bull put spreads follow account D's insider signals instead of account A's (A's signals have no edge); (3) long puts and bear call spreads paused until a bearish signal passes the finder. Judged against SPY.
summary: From 20 Oct: one SPY put spread a week (selling insurance on the S&P 500), plus calls and put spreads on account D's insider signals. Bearish playbooks paused (no tested bearish signal); positions opened before keep their own exit rules.
